課程綱要.課程名稱(英文): Special Course on Seismic Studies on Atmospheric, Hydrospheric, and Lithospheric Processes
課程綱要.課程目標: This year, we will focus on using onshore and offshore seismic waveforms to study earthquake locations and other different source processes
課程綱要.授課內容:
This graduate-level course introduces modern data processing techniques for investigating seismic source processes originating in the atmosphere, ocean, and lithosphere. The course emphasizes both the theoretical foundations and practical applications of seismological methods. Students will learn the underlying physics and mathematics of a range of seismic analysis techniques, with particular attention to their limitations and capabilities for building models of natural and anthropogenic processes.
Applications focus on the use of onshore and offshore seismic waveform data to study point sources, line sources, and finite source processes. By the end of the course, students will be equipped with a deeper understanding of source characterization and its role in advancing seismological research.

課程綱要.開課單位: 地球系統科學國際研究生博士學位學程
課程綱要.課程目標: Upon completion of the course, students will be able to: (1) Compare and multiple perspectives on the sustainability of the anthroposphere, including the environment- human relationships, societal systems, environmental governance, and integrated methods. (2) Build knowledge about how humans impact environments. (3) Understand the risks and opportunities as the societal system requires a shift. (4) Discover the importance of environmental governance in moving beyond business as usual. (5) Explore diverse approaches to sustainability challenges that could help build sustainable human-environment systems.
課程綱要.授課內容:
The course objectives are addressed through four core modules:
(1) Module 1: Environment-Human interactions
­ Critically analyze the past, present, and future of the anthroposphere and the implications for getting into sustainable development.
­ Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of the role of humans as a cause of – but also solution to – environmental problems.
­ Develop enough understanding to navigate and critically analyze the key aspects and developments in health and environment deterioration.
(2) Module 2: Societal systems
­ Engage critically with the resilient urban system through the lens of living-space management.
­ Consider the interlinkages between different environmental compartments such as water, food, and energy from a management perspective.
­ Develop a critical understanding of the trajectories of the sustainable system for consumption and production.
(3) Module 3: Environmental Governance
­ Understand environmental ethics that are re-shaping social and environmental relationships.
­ Integrate transition possible in each of the socio-technical frontiers of governance into policy analysis.
­ Learn and apply methods for risk assessment and integrate relevant natural science knowledge.
­ Apply methods, concepts, and frameworks to case study material on multiple conflicting interests between government and stakeholders.
(4) Module 4: Integration and Methodology
­ Compare and critique frameworks for contextualizing transdisciplinary approaches that might drive and accelerate change towards sustainable development.
­ Acquire the ability to go from real-world problems with these features to possible solutions.
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: Tom Theis, Sustainability: A Comprehensive Foundation, 2015

課程綱要.授課內容: 本課程提供地震學的理論基礎，帶領學生深入了解波動方程在不同與地震學相關的連續介質中的數學與物理推導及其解法。透過地震學公式的理論推導與實務範例的結合，學生將能進一步掌握多種地震學方法的進階知識，包括其相似性與差異性，以及在實際應用中的運用。

課程綱要.課程目標: 1.瞭解衛星影像基本概念及未來發展趨勢 2.認識並熟悉衛星影像處理軟體介面 3.瞭解衛星影像資料與判釋
課程綱要.授課內容: 在21世紀，人類所累積的知識與技術達到前所未有的境界，「巨量資料」時代已經降臨，在商業、經濟及其他領域中，決策將日益基於資料和分析而作出，而非基於經驗和直覺。除去對新興技術的理解，身處在資訊時代的我們，面對未來的鉅變，做了什麼樣的準備呢？科技與人文應促進兩者間之良性互動，截長補短，攜手合作，以提升人類的生活品質，共創美好的前景。爰此101學年度起，上下學期分別開設「空間資訊數位研究」及「數位影像與社會變遷」，教授記錄臺灣多元族群、人文地理、環境變遷之科學方法，開啟整合科技與人文教育之契機。
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: 講義、指定文章及蒐集文獻

課程綱要.課程目標: • 理解地球系統模式的基本原理與核心概念 • 實際操作台灣地球系統模式。 • 解析模式結果，培養科學分析能力
課程綱要.授課內容: 本課程介紹地球系統模式（Earth System Models, ESMs），內容涵蓋其科學原理、數值方法，以及在氣候研究中的實際應用。課程特別著重於地球系統模式中的大氣模組，以及它與其他模組之間的交互作用。教學方式包含講授、學術論文討論，以及以台灣地球系統模式（Taiwan Earth System Model, TaiESM）為基礎的模式操作與資料分析實作。

課程綱要.開課單位: 地球系統科學國際研究生博士學位學程
課程綱要.課程目標: Use and application of marine micropaleontology through observation and interpretation.
課程綱要.授課內容:
This course is based on the book “Applied Paleontology”. Marine palaeontology has developed from a descriptive science to an analytical science used to interpret relationships between earth and life history. Applied Palaeontology adopts a holistic, integrated approach to palaeontology, highlighting its key role in the study of the evolving earth, life history and environmental processes.
After an introduction to fossils and their classification, each of the principal marine fossil groups are discussed in detail, covering their biology, morphology, classification, palaeobiology and biostratigraphy. The latter sections focus on the applications of fossils in the interpretation of earth and life processes and environments. It concludes with case histories of how our knowledge of fossils is applied, in industry and elsewhere. Practical lectures will be included to identify and interpret microfossils using a microscope.
This is a valuable reference for anyone who is planning to get involved in the applications of palaeontology including earth, life and environmental science, as well as petroleum, minerals, mining and engineering applications.
課程綱要.評量配分比重: Class participation; mid-term literature presentation + report; final exam a microscope exercise + report using different kinds of samples.
